lines.a: Would you be free from the burden of sin?
lines.b: 你願從你的罪擔釋放麼？

lines.a: There's power in the blood, power in the blood
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
lines.b: 你願勝過一切惡性情麼？

lines.a: There's wonderful power in the blood
Would you be free from your passion and pride?
lines.b: 你願從驕傲私慾釋放麼？

lines.a: There's power in the blood, power in the blood
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide
lines.b: 各各他血泉內潔淨罪過

lines.a: There's wonderful power in the blood
Would you be whiter, much whiter than snow?
lines.b: 你願被潔淨比雪還白麼？

lines.a: There's power in the blood, power in the blood
Sin-stains are lost in its life-giving flow
lines.b: 這生命泉能潔淨你罪惡

lines.a: there's wonderful power in the blood
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
lines.b: 你願為主你君王做工麼？

lines.a: There's power in the blood, power in the blood
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
lines.b: 你願日日唱得勝凱歌麼？

lines.a: There's wonderful power in the blood
There is power, power, wonder-working power
In the blood of the Lamb
There is power, power, wonder-working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb
And the blood has never lost it power
No never, no never
Jesus blood avails for sin forever
And will never lose it’s power
